reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: Al addition to CoCrFeNi is well-known to induce an FCC-to-BCC transition and improve strength/creep resistance, and Al promotes protective alumina formation for corrosion resistance, though the specific 0.7 mol fraction and simultaneous improvement of all three properties at room temperature are not fully justified.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements (nanoindentation creep, potentiodynamic polarization, XRD/TEM) and a decisive falsification criterion based on statistically significant improvements and phase/oxide confirmation.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the research question with a specific, actionable intervention and a well-structured test, making it highly useful for guiding experimental work on aerospace fastener alloys.
